title: Audit & access logs: export options, retention windows, and deletion workflow
text:
Audit & access logs: export options, retention windows, and deletion workflow

["From: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-corp.com>\\nTo: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Raj Kumar <raj.kumar@globex.com>\\nDate: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800\\nSubject: Quick Q: audit/access logs retention & export capabilities\\n\\nHi Soojin,\\n\\nWe're finalizing our control matrix for the upcoming vendor review and had two specific asks on logs:\\n\\n1) What are the default retention windows you offer for (a) audit logs (admin actions/console/API-level) and (b) access logs (token usage, request-level telemetry) in the Hosted product?\\n2) Can customers export logs (audit + access) on-demand to customer-owned S3 / GCS with schema and retention preservation? Is there an automated scheduled export option?\\n3) If a customer requests deletion for a tenant (GDPR / data subject request), what is the deletion workflow for logs and how do you prove removal?\\n\\nWe're primarily interested in Hosted but curious about Dedicated/Private options too.\\n\\nAppreciate a concise breakdown and any links to docs or templates we can attach to the control questionnaire.\\n\\nBest,\\nDana\\nSecurity Operations\\nAcme Corp\\n\\n---\\nAttachment: security-questionnaire-answers.pdf (stub)", "From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-corp.com>\\nCc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:06:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Quick Q: audit/access logs retention & export capabilities\\n\\nHi Dana — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise Q&A and the practical steps we recommend for your control matrix.\\n\\nSummary (short):\\n- Hosted defaults: access logs = 90 days; audit (configuration/admin) logs = 365 days.\\n- Exports: Hosted supports both ad-hoc API exports and scheduled delivery to customer-owned S3 (NDJSON/CSV); Dedicated/Private can extend retention or keep logs in customer VPC.\\n- Deletion: We support tenant-level deletion requests. Hosted uses a coordinated soft-delete → purge pipeline with signed attestations and export logs to demonstrate completion; Private deployments can run local purge jobs per policy.\\n\\nDetail:\\n1) Retention windows (Hosted):\\n  - Access logs (ingress/egress request traces, token-level): default 90 days; configurable up to 13 months for enterprise contracts.\\n  - Audit logs (console/admin/API changes, privilege changes, service-account activity): default 365 days; configurable up to 3 years for compliance plans.\\n  - Notes: retention can be set per-tenant in Dedicated and Private, subject to resource/contract limits.\\n\\n2) Export capabilities:\\n  - On-demand exports: Console and Logs API provide ad-hoc exports (NDJSON or CSV) for both audit and access logs.\\n  - Scheduled exports: We offer scheduled delivery (daily/weekly) to customer-owned S3 buckets (AWS) or GCS buckets (via signed-transfer). Exports include a manifest + schema file and an integrity checksum (SHA256).\\n  - Formats & schema: audit logs use NDJSON with canonical fields (timestamp, actor_id, actor_ip, action, resource_type, before/after) ; access logs include request_id, model, token_counts, latency_ms, response_status. We attach a matrix with field mapping.\\n  - Immutable exports: For regulated customers we can configure WORM (write-once) export objects and signed manifests to satisfy retention and tamper-evidence requirements.\\n\\n3) Deletion & erasure workflow (Hosted):\\n  - Step 1: Customer submits deletion request through Console or Support (specify tenant id and scope).\\n  - Step 2: We mark data as 'to-be-deleted' (logical/soft delete) and remove indexed access; we begin deletion of hot-store copies immediately.\\n  - Step 3: Background purge job deletes cold/archival copies within the configured purge window (default 30 days; can be shortened with contract terms).\\n  - Step 4: For auditability we provide a signed deletion attestation (timestamp, scope, operator id) and an export of the pre-deletion manifest showing objects removed.\\n  - Caveats: If logs have been exported to customer-owned buckets, Redwood cannot remove copies from those buckets; we document this exception in the attestation.\\n\\n4) Demonstrating removal / evidence for auditors:\\n  - Signed deletion attestation (PDF) with job id and hashes.\\n  - Pre/post manifests showing object ids removed.\\n  - Audit trail entries (immutable) that show the deletion operation (operator, timestamp).\\n\\n5) Private/Dedicated specifics:\\n  - Dedicated: We can increase retention SLA and route scheduled exports into your VPC-managed buckets. Deletion timelines are identical but performed under your tenancy control for on-prem storage.\\n  - Private (on-prem): You control the retention and purge windows; Redwood provides the tooling and a recommended purge playbook.\\n\\nReferences & next steps:\\n- Export policy matrix attached: export-policy-matrix.pdf (maps fields & retention options).\\n- Console docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/logs#exports\\n- If you want, we can provision a scheduled export trial to your S3 for 7 days so your SOC team can inspect schema and manifests.\\n\\nAction items:\\n- Dana: confirm whether you want a one-time export sample to your S3 or a 7-day scheduled trial.\\n- Neha: I will need the account/tenant id to generate the sample and the S3 bucket ARN if they choose trial.\\n\\nLet me know if you'd like this condensed into a single control text snippet we can paste into your vendor questionnaire.\\n\\nThanks,\\nSoojin Lee\\nSecurity & Compliance Solutions\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\n---\\nAttachment: export-policy-matrix.pdf (stub)", 'From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800\\nSubject: Fwd: Quick Q: audit/access logs retention & export capabilities\\n\\nSoojin / Marcus — looping you both to confirm commercial constraints: if Acme requests a 7-year retention export (they asked verbally), do we need a special contract term or is it covered by Dedicated/Enterprise options? Also, is there a SKU for scheduled export delivery or is that part of the Premium compliance add-on?\\n\\nMarcus, can you advise on pricing and whether we need legal to add export-specific language?\\n\\nOne-liner for sales playbook: \\"Scheduled log exports to customer-owned buckets available with Enterprise/Dedicated plans; long-term retention and immutable exports require compliance add-on.\\"\\n\\nCheers,\\nNeha\\nSr. Solutions Engineer\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\nOn Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 12:06 PM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> Hi Dana — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise Q&A and the practical steps we recommend for your control matrix.\\n> \\n> [snip — full reply above]\\n', 'From: Dana Li <dana.li@acme-corp.com>\\nTo: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Raj Kumar <raj.kumar@globex.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Audit & access logs: export options, retention windows, and deletion workflow\\n\\nThanks — that is super helpful. We want two things to start:\\n\\n1) A 7-day scheduled export trial into our S3 so our SOC can validate the manifest/schema and checksums. Our bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::acme-security-logs-test.\\n2) Clarification in writing that if we request tenant-level deletion, Redwood will provide a signed deletion attestation and the pre-deletion manifest; please include the line about exported copies in customer buckets being out of scope.\\n\\nAlso attaching the questionnaire we shipped to procurement — it has a couple of small cross-references to the control IDs you covered.\\n\\nIf you can set up the export trial and send the attestation language we can close this control.\\n\\nBest,\\nDana\\nSecurity Operations\\nAcme Corp\\n\\n---\\nAttachment: security-questionnaire-answers.pdf (stub)']
